message:
## Vulnerability Digest

One new vulnerability credibly matching the monitored product list was reported in the last 24 hours. The review window was 2026-08-08 23:40 UTC through 2026-08-09 23:40 UTC (2026-08-09 05:10 IST through 2026-08-10 05:10 IST).

**Finding 1**

- **Affected product/component:** WordPress — Iptanus File Upload plugin before 5.1.8
- **Vulnerability:** CVE-2026-17044 — unauthenticated SQL injection via `uniqueuploadid`
- **Severity:** Not stated in the authoritative CVE record
- **Description:** The plugin does not adequately sanitize and escape a request parameter before using it in a SQL statement, allowing an unauthenticated user to inject SQL.
- **Why it is relevant:** Iptanus File Upload is a WordPress plugin, directly matching the monitored WordPress product family.
- **Sources:** [CVE Project record](https://github.com/CVEProject/cvelistV5/blob/main/cves/2026/17xxx/CVE-2026-17044.json); [WPScan advisory](https://wpscan.com/vulnerability/364c99a4-4ce9-4e5f-bccc-2b4081e4031d/)

Prompt review is recommended for WordPress deployments using Iptanus File Upload because the reported issue is remotely reachable without authentication. No other new or newly updated CVE record in the monitoring window could be tied confidently to the listed products; routine metadata updates to older vulnerabilities and loosely related component-name matches were excluded.
